# Withdrawn and newly reported

What changed between the previous run and this one. Both are archived in [`../runs/data/`](../../runs/data/), so any row here can be traced.

The baseline is the run before the divisor rework, so this page is cumulative rather than a single step. Four defects account for it: [TOOLBUG-017](../../toolbugs/TOOLBUG-017-divisor-reported-parameters-not-denominators.md) (every parameter inside a denominator reported without checking that the denominator could vanish), [TOOLBUG-018](../../toolbugs/TOOLBUG-018-ir-lost-the-symbol-contract.md) (the IR could not distinguish a constant from a settable parameter), [TOOLBUG-019](../../toolbugs/TOOLBUG-019-two-valued-divisor-classification.md) (a path the analysis could not decide was treated as reachable) and [TOOLBUG-020](../../toolbugs/TOOLBUG-020-zero-behaviour-was-decided-three-times.md) (three detectors deciding separately what zero meant). Nothing here was withdrawn for being inconvenient; each withdrawal is a claim that did not hold.
